title: SZFE university blockade: earlier physical action and online resistance

start_date.summary: ACLED describes the occupation starting in early September 2020; no exact day is assigned.

end_date.summary: The January 25 retrospective explicitly dates the final Vas street gathering and physical moving out to November 10, 2020.

january_presence.summary: Sources describe subsequent online resistance and a break in street activity. No physical January continuation is established.

summary: Historical ownership and closure check, not evidence of a physically continuous January occupation.
notes: Political or institutional resistance may persist after physical withdrawal. This record prevents treating January publication dates as new assemblies.
